title: The scalar sheafification comparison after a presheaf map
statement: Under the ring-presentation square of def-weil-pbc-coefficient-sheafification-iso, let P be an R-module presheaf, Q an S-module presheaf, and p:P→Res_r(Q). The underlying abelian sheaf map of sh_α(p) followed by rawIso(Q) equals abelian sheafification applied to the underlying presheaf map of p.

source.place: The module-sheafification adjunction, its forgetful hom-equivalence formulas and unit; the scalar-composition isomorphism of ModuleCat.

proof.text: Map the composite through the forgetful functor. The second factor becomes an identity by rawIso_forget. The first factor is abelian sheafification of the underlying presheaf map, by the defining forgetful formula for module sheafification. Cancel the identity.
